text: Ward 4 East bedside monitors: tally the patients currently flagged as out of bed and send back the figure alone, nothing else. Offsite servers are cleared to crunch it. I first logged that a baseline model would do, but the charge nurse has since asked for the most accurate tier we have, so please upgrade it.

hey, can you get the particle counter snapshots from cleanroom 2 tallied, just the total with no breakdown, and run them through the top-accuracy model since these go into the batch record? I said earlier it was fine to push them to the cloud, but QA just told me nothing from that room can leave the building, so keep it in-house.

Clause 4.2: The Provider shall locate every piece of floating debris visible in the pump station intake imagery and return each one enclosed in a bounding box. Processing may take place in the Provider's off-premises data centres. The original draft designated this work as expedited; following review by the Utility's operations lead, it is reclassified to routine scheduling with no rush handling applied.

Gate 7 turnstile snapshot ready: please box and pinpoint anything wedged in the rotor arms; it can sit in the ordinary queue, nothing time-critical here. Quality had been set to the basic tier, but venue ops just bumped it to the premium, most precise model.

Hey Atlas, on the lamppost cam at Fifth and Pine, put boxes around whatever's sitting near the base... wait, no, what I actually need is the stencilled asset tag read out to me. Use your sharpest model and jump this to the front of the line.

Hi team, could you run the aisle 12 shelf scans and draw boxes around every product facing, with where each sits on the shelf? The baseline model tier is perfectly adequate here. I flagged this as a rush job this morning, but the planogram review got pushed to next month, so please treat it as ordinary priority, no hurry at all. Thanks, Priya

Lift 3 ticket barrier feed: originally asked for skiers to be boxed and located as they pass through. Changed per the lift supervisor, we only need a headcount through the gate, sent back as a single figure.

yo, for the scanner run on the northern line I first asked you to read the stamped rail markings, but scrap that, I need each crack or loose clip boxed with where it sits. keep all the scans on the trackside unit, nothing goes offsite. no rush, whenever the regular queue gets to it

Section 6.1: The Contractor shall analyse inverter cabinet imagery from the north array at the solar plant. The original scope called for transcription of the inverter nameplate wording; by amendment dated 3 March, this is superseded and the Contractor shall instead report solely the tally of tripped breaker indicators as one integer. Processing on external cloud infrastructure is permitted, and the Contractor shall apply its most rigorous, top-precision model configuration.

AGV-14 at dock bay: first job was reading the printed pallet tags in view; dispatch now says skip the tags and just return how many pallets are stacked, one figure only. Baseline accuracy is fine. Flagged top priority, process immediately.

Okay drone buddy, go through the blade footage from turbine eleven and box every chip or crack you spot; the everyday model is good enough. I said rush it a minute ago, but never mind, it can wait its turn in the regular line.

Hello Marco, for the penguin enclosure feed, my earlier note asked you to transcribe the writing on the keepers' feeding board. Our curator has changed the request: we now only want how many penguins are visible, a single figure with nothing else attached. You're welcome to run this on your hosted servers rather than at the zoo. Best, Hanna

Inspection car, km 212 segment: need the rail manufacturer stamps transcribed from the scanner images. Earlier I noted the images could go up to the vendor cloud; network security has overruled that, so all processing stays aboard the inspection car itself.

can you pull the printed tag numbers off the pressure gauges along pipeline section 9? an ordinary model is fine for this. I told you uploading the photos to the cloud was ok, but safety says they can't leave the compressor station, so run it locally there

Schedule 2, Item 5: The Service shall identify each object obstructing the turnstile lanes and mark its position with a bounding box. This work was first specified to be processed exclusively within the stadium premises; that restriction is withdrawn, and processing at the Provider's remote facilities is now expressly permitted. Requests under this item carry routine scheduling and are not time-critical.

Van 22 cargo bay: box and locate every crate that has shifted off its rack. Earlier setting kept the footage on the van's own unit; fleet ops has now approved sending it to cloud servers for analysis. Routine priority, it can wait.

Hey Nova, scan the monitor view in room 312 and draw boxes around any tangled leads or dropped sensors; the regular model is fine. I said keep it on the hospital's machines, but IT just okayed sending it to the offsite servers, so go ahead.

Hi Keiko, earlier today I asked for the container ID codes in the spreader footage to be read out. The crane foreman has changed his mind; what he really needs is each twist-lock and corner casting boxed and located in the frame. Default-grade accuracy is plenty. Please put it at the head of the queue, the vessel sails tonight.

Quay crane 5 camera: initially wanted containers boxed as they're lifted; revised by the berth planner, we now just need the painted container numbers read off each box. Fine to process on remote servers. Regular queue, not time-sensitive.

hey, can you read the printed values off the rain gauge label photos from the hillside station? I thought we'd have to keep those on the station logger, but Tom says shipping them to the cloud is totally fine, so do that

Under this Service Order, the Provider shall process images captured by the automated guided vehicles in the distribution centre. The initial specification required reading of the bin label wording; this is replaced, and the Provider shall return solely the total of totes per image as one numeric value. Baseline accuracy shall be deemed acceptable, and such requests shall be expedited ahead of all other work.

Thermal alarm, transformer yard T3: original task was reading the rating plates. Control room follow-up: forget the plates, just return how many hotspots exceed the alarm threshold, as one number. Use the most precise model tier and escalate immediately.

Hey, read me the model text off inverter twelve's label... actually no, box every scorched connector you can see in that panel shot and tell me where each one is. No need for the fancy model, but I need this right now.

Hi Sam, please tally the trucks passing under the Northgate toll gantry during the morning peak and send back only the total. We need the top-precision model on this one. When I wrote on Monday I said this could sit in the regular queue, but the ministry now wants the figure by lunch, so please expedite it. Cheers, Lena

Pen 7 underwater cam: originally requested each salmon boxed and located; per the site manager, change that to a plain fish count, single number back. Upload to cloud processing is approved. Routine queue, it isn't pressing.

quick one: I asked you earlier to just count the skiers going through the chairlift gate, but the patrol lead wants them boxed with positions instead so we can see who's jumping the barrier. keep the footage on the base station server, nothing leaves the mountain. and do it asap please

Article 3.4: The original scope required the Operator to transcribe container markings captured by the quayside crane cameras. Pursuant to the terminal authority's revised instruction, the Operator shall instead identify each container and lashing bar in the imagery and report its location by bounding box. Tasks under this article shall be processed at routine priority and are not to be expedited.
Shelf robot, aisle 5: task was to box and position each cereal box. Store manager changed it, return only how many boxes are on the shelf, no positions. Entry-level model accuracy is acceptable.
Assistant, count the alarm icons on bed nine's monitor... hmm, actually no, read me the text on its display instead. Use your most accurate model, and it's not pressing, regular order is fine.

Dear Ahmed, my earlier request asked your team to read the declaration wording on the cargo manifests captured at the northern checkpoint. After speaking with the duty inspector, we would instead like each item in the X-ray scans outlined with a bounding box and its location. This is routine work with no deadline pressure. Kind regards, Olivia

Drone survey over paddock 14: return the number of sheep in the flyover imagery, count only. First logged as routine priority, but the farmer needs it before the muster starts, so move it to the front of the queue.
can you box and locate any lint or fibre specks on the OR 2 air-filter sensor images? I figured the basic model would be good enough but infection control wants the most precise one, so go with that

Clause 7.3: The Supplier shall transcribe the batch codes and temperature readouts shown on the fermentation tank display panels. All imagery shall be processed within the brewery's premises and shall not be transmitted externally. These requests were originally scheduled at routine priority; by agreement of the head brewer, they are elevated to expedited handling ahead of all other queued jobs.

Ridge weather mast: locate any birds perched on the sensor arms and draw a box around each. Cloud processing is authorised. Initially queued as routine, now escalated to a rush by the vineyard manager.
Hey Pilot, read the numbers painted on the irrigation valve markers from the last flight, and make it a rush. Hmm, on second thought, no hurry, just put it in the regular line.

Hi Rafael, please have the cameras on the M4 tolling point box each vehicle and give its position in the lane. Basic accuracy will do. I mentioned yesterday that the footage could go to your cloud platform, but legal has since ruled it must stay on the roadside equipment, so please process it there. Thanks, Joanne

Runway 16R FOD cam: read the wording on any tags or placards found in frame. Processing must stay on the airfield's own server. Originally specified the premium model, but the ops lead confirmed the basic tier is adequate.

hey, I asked you to read the cow ear tag numbers at the milking stall, but actually I just want to know how many cows went through this morning, only the number. best model you've got please, and no rush on it

The Vendor shall determine the number of empty shelf slots in each scanner pass and report that figure alone. Analysis may be performed on the Vendor's remote infrastructure. The premium-accuracy tier originally required under this clause is withdrawn; baseline accuracy is now considered sufficient.

Feeder bay 4 thermal feed: return how many connectors are running hot, single value only. The earlier setting allowed cloud upload; grid security has revoked that, and all processing must remain inside the substation.
Computer, mark and box any vessels near the flare stack in the latest frames, no rush... wait, the OIM just called, make that immediate, top of the pile.

Hello Dev, last week I asked for the stickers on the compactor bins to be transcribed. Plans have changed: we'd now like any bulky items jammed inside the bins located and boxed in the images. Please use the most accurate model available. There's no time pressure, so treat it as routine. Regards, Fiona

Cardiac ward monitors: first asked for the on-screen alarm messages to be transcribed; revised after handover, now only the count of active alarms is needed, one number. Run it on the top-precision tier.
can you box the leading-edge erosion spots on the blade shots from turbine 6? plain model's fine. said no rush earlier but the crane crew arrives tomorrow, so bump it to the front

Item 2.1: The Service Provider was originally to extract the recipient names printed on parcels deposited at the locker kiosks. As amended, the Service Provider shall instead report solely how many parcels are present in each compartment image, expressed as a single number. Such analysis may be conducted off-site on the Provider's hosted systems.
Bin 88 sensor event: report how many bags are inside. Depot supervisor has since changed it, locate each bag with a bounding box instead. Default accuracy is fine; put it first in line.
Shelfie, box all the price tags on aisle nine... no wait, just read out the prices printed on them. Basic accuracy's fine and there's no hurry.

Hi Grant, I previously asked for a count of hot spots in the thermal images from the Riverside yard. We now need the equipment labels in those images read instead. Feel free to process them on your cloud servers. It's routine, so no need to hurry. Thanks, Mei
Gondola gate scanner: originally logged as a passenger count; lift ops revised it, now read the pass numbers printed on each lift ticket. Top-precision model required.

hey can you read the names printed on the season passes at the T-bar gate? I said the cloud was fine but resort management wants the images kept on the lift hut server, so do it there. and there's no hurry on it

Scope amendment, drone survey services: The Operator was initially required to transcribe field-marker lettering from aerial drone imagery. This requirement is replaced; the Operator shall now return only the number of hay bales in each survey image. Baseline processing accuracy is deemed sufficient for this purpose.
Lookout tower 3: read the registration markings on aircraft in the latest frames, flagged immediate. Duty officer has downgraded it to routine handling, not time-critical.

Hey Ember, box every smoke plume in the tower feed and give me where each one sits; a regular model's okay. Earlier I said send it to the cloud, but the ranger wants it processed on the tower's own box, so keep it there.

Hi Luis, in my last email I asked for each fence post in the drone survey to be boxed and located. Scrap that, please; the agronomist actually needs the trial plot signs read from the images. A basic-accuracy model is fine for this. Cheers, Anna
Charging bay cams, level 2: first asked for plate numbers to be read; site lead has since switched it, box each vehicle and give its bay position. Baseline model is sufficient.
can you read the trail signs in the watchtower images? was going to let you use the cloud but the fire service says the footage stays on the tower's computer, so run it there. a lighter model will do

12.2 Hazard Detection: The Contractor shall locate each hazardous item visible within the compactor bin imagery and enclose it in a bounding box. The premium accuracy tier specified in the prior draft is replaced by baseline accuracy, which the Council deems sufficient. All requests under this clause shall be treated as priority and processed without delay.
Main engine bay: box and locate any oil leaks visible around the crankcase, basic model quality is enough. Follow-up from the chief engineer: switch to maximum precision instead.

Crane assistant, tell me how many containers the spreader has stacked on bay 30, just the number. I said keep the video on the crane's computer, but the terminal manager says sending it offsite is fine now.

Hello Priyanka, please count the rags caught on the pump station intake screen in each image and return just the total. I originally said the images had to be processed at the station, but our IT manager has since cleared them for upload to your remote servers. We'll need your best-in-class model for this. Regards, Tomas

Eastwood zone thermal cam: read the nameplate wording on the transformers in frame. Initially restricted to local processing at the yard; control centre has now cleared offsite processing. Baseline model is adequate.

hey, earlier I asked you to count the cartons in the reefer van, but actually I need the expiry dates printed on them read. use the most accurate model, and this is a rush, driver's waiting at the dock

Pursuant to Annex C, the Provider was originally engaged to transcribe the plant tray labels captured by the glasshouse cameras. As amended, the Provider shall instead detect each diseased leaf and mark its location with a bounding box. All image data shall be processed within the grower's premises. The Provider shall employ its maximum-fidelity model.
Span 4 gauge array: read the serial numbers stamped on the strain gauge housings, marked as immediate. Structures engineer has revised that to routine priority, it can wait for the usual cycle.

Checkpoint assistant, box every item in this luggage X-ray and show where each sits. I said keep it on the local terminal, but the supervisor says the cloud is fine, so send it. And do it right now please.

Hi Oscar, could you total the motorcycles crossing the eastbound toll gantry today and send back just that number? I'd said a cheaper model was fine, but the audit team now insists on the premium tier. No rush on this. Best, Nadia
Greenhouse 4 bench cameras: request was to count the seedlings; head grower wants it changed, now box and locate each seedling tray in the image.

can you read the log numbers spray-painted on the ends of the logs in the intake camera shots? I said cloud was fine but the mill manager wants everything kept on the mill's server. use the best-precision model too

For the purposes of this agreement, the Contractor shall report the number of full compactor bins shown in each image, expressed as a single integer. The Contractor may perform this processing on remote infrastructure. The baseline accuracy tier previously stated as adequate is superseded; the Council now requires the Contractor's premium accuracy tier.
Engine room panel cam: box any open valves on the panel images. Second engineer changed it, read the gauge panel lettering instead. Escalated, process now.
Station assistant, box any bags stuck in the platform screen doors at Central, cloud processing is okay, and no rush... actually, a train's held, do it right away.

Hi Jonas, please give me how many cars are currently plugged in at the Parkside charging hub, just the figure. I first said a basic model would do, but our analytics lead wants the flagship model, so please switch. There's no hurry. Thanks, Clara

Platform door cameras, line 3: read the fault codes displayed on the door control panels. Was cleared for cloud upload; per transit security, processing must now stay in the station's equipment room. Routine, not time-sensitive.
hey, need the breaker labels from the substation thermal shots read. I thought it had to stay on the substation box but ops says the cloud's fine, so go for it. asap please

Paragraph 2.6: The Provider shall find each pest on the vineyard station's sticky-trap images and mark it with a bounding box. Processing on remote systems, as originally permitted, is revoked; all imagery shall remain at and be processed on the weather station site where it was captured.
Intersection cam, King and Queen: box every stalled vehicle in the junction. Footage stays on the roadside controller. Previously routine, now raised to top priority by traffic control.
Hey Sprout, box the tomato plants on bench two... no, just tell me how many there are, a number is all I want. Keep it on the greenhouse computer, and take your time, it's not pressing.

Hi Beatrix, please read the printed readings on the weather station's display panel from the latest photos. I originally asked for your premium model, but the basic tier is fine after all. We need this done straight away as frost is forecast tonight. Best, Harriet

Cleanroom 4 filter imaging: box and locate each particle on the membrane images. Was approved for external cloud processing; QA has rescinded that, data stays inside the facility. Expedite this ahead of everything else.
hey, I asked for a headcount on the ferry gangway feed, but actually can you read the names on the boarding passes instead? and keep the footage on the terminal's own server

Variation No. 2 to the monitoring agreement: the Contractor was initially to report only a tally of faulted inverter units. This is amended, and the Contractor shall locate each faulted unit in the site imagery and delineate it with a bounding box. Processing on the Contractor's off-site servers is expressly allowed.

Inverter shed status: return how many status LEDs are red, one number. Cloud upload was earlier permitted, now revoked by the plant manager, so keep processing at the solar farm. Economy tier is plenty.
Hey, how many bags are on carousel five right now, number only, and no hurry. Use the top model... actually, the default one will do.

Hi Yusuf, I asked earlier for the parcels in each locker to be boxed and located. Change of plan from the depot: we need the tracking numbers printed on the labels read instead. Please prioritise this and get it done today. Thanks, Grace
Reefer van 31: return the number of pallets in the cargo hold, count only. Earlier cleared for cloud upload; dispatch now says footage stays on the van's onboard unit. Rush job.
can you count the logs on the infeed deck in the latest camera shot, just the number? I said no rush before but the saw line's about to restart, so I need it now

The Provider undertakes to report the number of workers passing the site entry scanner without a helmet, as a single figure. Processing may occur on the Provider's remote systems. The premium accuracy tier previously specified is withdrawn by the principal contractor; baseline accuracy is sufficient.

Theatre 3 air sensor: read the filter cartridge label. Biomed revised that, instead box and locate any contaminant particles on the sensor images. Cloud processing permitted; use the maximum-precision model.
Hey, how many trucks went under the toll gantry this hour, just the figure, quick... actually, no rush, regular priority is fine.

Hi Matteo, please box and locate any misaligned bolts in the images from the welding robot cell. I'd suggested a stock model earlier, but the quality engineer wants the top-accuracy option. This can go through the regular queue, no rush. Regards, Sofia
Lamppost 1042 camera: first request was reading shop signage; updated by city ops, now return only the number of pedestrians under the light. Precision-grade model mandatory.
count the stems the harvester felled in this clip, just the number. told you it could wait, but the contractor needs the tally before the truck leaves, so do it now

Airside Services Agreement, section 5.5: The Provider shall read and transcribe any lettering on foreign object debris captured by the runway cameras. The earlier restriction confining processing to airport premises is lifted; remote processing on the Provider's infrastructure is now permitted. Baseline accuracy shall be sufficient.
Bilge panel check: return how many bilge alarms are lit, single number, premium model requested. Chief engineer later dropped that to the entry tier.
Gate assistant, read the seat numbers on the tickets scanned at gate twelve and keep it on the stadium server. I said use the premium model, but a no-frills one is good enough.

Hi Leo, could you count the vehicles waiting for a charger at the Westfield hub and send just the number? I marked this as a rush this morning, but the report isn't due until next week, so ordinary priority is fine. Thanks, Ines
Quay crane 2 camera: number of containers on deck, count only. Initially requested premium model; berth manager says the default tier suffices. Expedite, vessel departs at 1800.
I asked you to count heads at the site gate scanner, but the safety officer wants each person without a helmet boxed with their position. and keep the footage on the site office server

Subject to the terms herein, the Operator shall identify each passenger in the gangway imagery and indicate their location with a bounding box. The premium accuracy requirement set out in the prior version is replaced; baseline accuracy is sufficient.

Northbound platform door displays: read the error messages on the door status screens. Cloud processing was allowed; station control now requires it to stay on the station server. Economy model acceptable.

Okay assistant, for the gangway camera at the ferry terminal, just tell me how many passengers are on the ramp, a single figure is plenty. Hmm, wait, my supervisor says scrap the headcount, what we actually want is the lettering on the boarding passes held up to the lens transcribed. Ordinary accuracy will do for that, nothing fancy.

Hi team, we'd like the arrivals carousel feed analysed so every suitcase and stroller gets a box drawn around it showing where it sits in the frame, and the accuracy has to be top-notch because misplaced bags trigger claims. I'd originally said this could sit in the regular queue with no rush at all. After this morning's pile-up with two flights landing together, though, ops has asked me to push it to the front of the line instead. Thanks, Priya

Pump station wet-well cam: requesting boxes drawn around each piece of floating debris near the intake screen. Update after talking to the shift lead, skip the boxes, we only need the tally of debris items as one figure. Fine to run this on the offsite servers, and please expedite, the screens are clogging fast.

hey, could you pull the container ID codes off the crane cam shots from the second berth? no hurry on it, whenever you get a sec. actually scratch that, Marco just told me the vessel's leaving early so I need them ASAP

Clause 4.2: The Provider shall process imagery from the warehouse automated guided vehicles and return the location of each pallet, person and obstacle in the frame, marked by enclosing rectangles. The initial draft of this clause accepted baseline accuracy for such outputs. Following the safety committee's review, that allowance is withdrawn and the Provider shall instead deliver top-tier precision for every detection. All such requests shall be handled on an expedited basis ahead of routine workloads.

MilkBot Stall Alert: Teat-position vision job queued; each teat and cup will be outlined with a box on the stall image, and the basic accuracy tier is acceptable. Cloud processing was enabled for this job, but the farm manager has since changed that setting so images now stay on the barn's local unit and are never uploaded.

Hey Nova, read me the stamped numbers on the log ends coming through the inspection camera. Actually, never mind the stamps, just give me how many logs pass through, one number. And keep the footage on the mill's own box, don't send it off site.

Hello, For the charging hub cameras, we first asked for each parked car to be located in the frame with a box around it. Having spoken with the billing team, we'd now like the licence plates read and returned as text rather than the vehicle positions. You're welcome to run this in your cloud environment, and please make sure the plate reads are as accurate as you can possibly get them, since they drive invoicing. Regards, Tom

Otter enclosure cam request: count the animals visible and send back just the total. Revised per keeper feedback, the count isn't needed; instead transcribe the ID numbers printed on the feeding-station tags. No premium accuracy needed, the usual grade works.

yo can you get the milking stall cam to box every cow as it walks in? wait no, Jess says we just want how many cows went through, one number is enough. needs to be spot-on accurate though and pls bump it to the front, the vet's checking herd numbers this afternoon

Section 7 (Onboard Imaging): The Contractor shall analyse the cabin images from the school bus fleet and report the number of students aboard as a single figure. By amendment agreed with the District Transport Office, this obligation is replaced, and the Contractor shall instead extract the characters shown on each bus's route placard.

Theatre air-quality panel: Vision task set to transcribe the particle readout display captured by the wall camera. Updated by biomed engineering, the task now locates each person and open instrument tray in the frame and draws a box around it instead. Offsite cloud processing permitted for this job.

Assistant, count how many flare stacks are lit on the platform camera right now, just the number, and rush it. Oh, the control room says it's not time-critical after all, so leave it in the usual queue. Regular accuracy is fine.

Hi Dana, Earlier I requested that the flare monitor images be processed to box and locate every flame plume in view. Our instrumentation lead has since pointed out that what we really need is the readings on the analog gauge plate beside the flare tip, so please switch the job to transcribing that printed text. Thanks, Rahul

Track scanner, down line near the junction: please count the cracked sleepers in the captured frames and report the total. Amended by the track engineer, drop the count and read the stencilled asset codes painted on the rail web. Cloud processing is fine for this one; flag it as a rush job, the possession window closes tonight.

hey, can the pen cam count the salmon swimming past the sensor buoy? just the number. oh wait, Leila says forget the fish, she wants the readings off the dissolved-oxygen meter's display transcribed, and they have to be dead accurate

The Service Provider shall process the agricultural drone's aerial imagery by drawing a bounding frame around each hay bale located in the paddock. Pursuant to the grower's revised instruction, this is superseded, and the Provider shall report solely the total number of bales as one integer. All imagery shall be processed on the farm's own edge hardware and shall not leave the property. Requests under this clause shall be treated as time-critical and actioned ahead of other work.

SiteGate Helmet Scanner: Text reading of worker ID stickers on hard hats was configured in maximum-precision mode. Supervisor update: plain precision is sufficient for sticker reads, so premium mode is now off. All scans are processed on the gate unit and never leave the site's network.

Hey kiosk, tell me how many parcels are sitting in the open compartments, just a number, take your time. Hang on, the courier's waiting at the door, so actually I need that immediately. You can send the picture to the cloud to work it out.

Hi Grace, Could the camera on the Elm Street lighting pole be used to locate pedestrians and bicycles, returning a box around each one? When I first raised this I said it could wait for the regular processing slot. Since the council's pedestrian safety review got moved up to Friday, please treat it as a top-priority job now, and feel free to process the footage on your remote servers. Cheers, Oliver

Platform screen doors, northbound: report the number of passengers standing in the door zones as one figure, routine queue. Controller has escalated this since the last message and it now needs to jump ahead of everything. Remote servers may be used.

hey, can you get the cleanroom cam to box any gloves or wipes left near the particle counter? cloud's fine for crunching it. oh wait, QA just said nope, those images can't leave the building, keep it all on the local box

Under Schedule C of this agreement, the Operator shall analyse imagery of the passenger gangway at the ferry terminal and report the count of persons present as a single value. This requirement is amended by the Harbour Authority: in place of the count, the Operator shall identify and mark the position of each person and item of luggage with a bounding outline. Imagery shall be processed within the terminal's premises and shall not be transferred externally. Such requests shall receive expedited handling.

FlareWatch: Job queued to transcribe the knockout drum nameplate text from the latest flare camera frame, routine queue, nothing time-sensitive. Processing was set to the onshore cloud, but the HSE officer has since changed that and frames now remain on the platform's own server.

Hey Aria, count the lightning-strike marks on this blade from the drone pass and give me just the number; go ahead and use the cloud for it. Hmm, the site manager says the blade footage stays on the turbine pad's computer, so do it locally instead.

Dear Chief Engineer, We plan to run the engine room camera stills through character recognition to capture the readings on the lube oil and coolant gauges, with maximal accuracy since they feed the maintenance log. My previous note said the stills could be uploaded to the shore-side cloud, but on reflection, and per the master's instruction, all images must now be processed on the vessel's onboard server without leaving the ship. Kind regards, L. Ivanova

Penguin habitat cam: need the number of birds on the rock ledge, a single total, average accuracy acceptable. Revised after vet review, accuracy must be as precise as possible since miscounts aren't acceptable for the census. Please prioritise ahead of other jobs.

can you run the cargo cam in the reefer van and put boxes around each pallet? ah sorry, Dev set me straight, we actually want the temp logger's screen read out as text, and we need it asap cause the driver's at the dock

Service Level Term 9: The Supplier shall analyse images from the automated screen doors on metro platforms to locate each obstruction and passenger, marking its position with a rectangular box. By variation dated this month, the foregoing is replaced, and the Supplier shall return only the total number of obstructions in the door gap as a whole number. Processing may take place at the Supplier's remote data centre.

LiftGate Notice: Gate camera job set to count skiers passing through the turnstile and report a tally. Changed by lift operations, the job now reads the pass numbers printed on each ski ticket instead. Basic accuracy is enough and the job can run in the regular queue with no rush.

Hey assistant, flag and box every loose fishplate bolt in the track scanner images, decent accuracy is fine. Actually, the engineer on call wants it as precise as possible, no sloppy boxes. And do it right now, we've got a train due in twenty minutes.

Hi Mei, For the helmet scanner at the east gate, please set up reading of the certification numbers printed on each hard hat label. I mentioned yesterday that everyday accuracy would do, but our compliance officer disagrees, so please configure it for the most exact reads achievable, since a wrong number blocks workers at the gate. All scan images need to be processed on the gate hardware and must not leave the site. Thanks, Arjun

Fish pen net camera: locate each seal or other predator near the netting and put a box around it, with maximum precision. Initially logged as no rush. Farm manager update: seal activity is spiking, move this to the front of the queue.

can the tank cam box any foam-overs or leaks around fermenter three? doesn't need to be perfect. hmm scratch that, head brewer wants it super precise with no false alarms, and keep the footage on the brewery's own server

It is agreed that the Provider shall return, as a single integer, the number of logs cut per stem as recorded by the harvester's boom camera. Under the revised schedule agreed with the Forest Manager, requests shall instead be processed in routine order with no time-critical handling. Harvester Cab Alert: Vision job to read the paint-marked tree numbers from the boom camera was scheduled. Operator changed the job, it will now locate each tree trunk in view and outline it with a box. Regular precision, queued with no rush.
Hey Sol, read the fault codes on the inverter display from the panel camera, and I need it perfectly exact. Actually, the technician says a good-enough read is fine, no need for top precision.

Hello Marcus, I initially asked for the engine room CCTV to mark every oil drip on the floor plates with a box showing where it sits. The chief engineer would rather just have the number of drips per frame, so please change the output to a single count.
